# GitHub Resources DOX

## Purpose

- Own public repository and root-README image assets.

## Local Contracts

- Keep README-facing assets at stable repository-relative paths with concise descriptive alt text at each use site.
- Use `banner.webp` as the root README's leading banner and `jan.jpeg` as its founder portrait.
- Keep the three feature illustrations here as `readme-one-human-one-chat.webp`, `readme-infinite-leverage.webp`, and `readme-quality.webp`.
- The README banner includes one YouTube play button slightly inset at the bottom-right corner and links to `https://youtu.be/-dq5PkLdAZ0`, titled “Spynel - manage ALL of your AI work with one chat.”
- Keep the banner at 800×267 and the feature illustrations at 400×400, compressed as WebP with subtle rounded transparent corners; preserve the artwork and use alpha rather than page-colored corners or README CSS.
- Avoid duplicate copies of these assets under `docs/`.

## Child DOX Index

No child DOX files.
